name: Nebula Orb
description: A glowing WebGL nebula sphere with domain-warped noise, fresnel rim and halo that follows the pointer and pulses on click.

name: Liquid Metal
description: Chrome metaballs rendered in WebGL with environment reflections that merge, drift and follow your cursor; hold to gather them.

name: Mesh Gradient Hero
description: A silky, slowly flowing mesh gradient with film grain behind a landing-page hero, cycling palettes and bending toward the pointer.

name: Voice Wave
description: Voice-assistant ribbons of additive sine lobes that react to a scripted transcript; hold anywhere (or Space) to talk.

name: Chroma Ring
description: A raymarched iridescent torus with travelling light streaks and colour bloom; drag to tilt and fling it into a spin.

name: Cinematic Carousel
description: An infinite film-poster carousel with depth, scale and blur on side cards, ambient colour glow, spring snapping, drag, arrows and autoplay.

name: 3D Album Carousel
description: A CSS 3D ring of album covers with reflections, depth dimming, inertial drag and a now-playing pill that follows the front card.

name: Logo & Quote Marquee
description: Two counter-scrolling infinite rows of wordmarks and testimonials with soft edge fades that ease to a stop on hover and can be dragged.

name: Activity Rings
description: Fitness-style activity rings with overlap past 100%, counting legend values and a week strip that animates between days.

name: Revenue Line Chart
description: A smooth gradient area chart that draws in, morphs between 1W/1M/3M/1Y ranges and shows a snapped crosshair tooltip on hover.

name: Paywall Screen
description: A full mobile paywall with glowing app-icon hero, feature list, yearly/monthly plan selector with savings badge, shimmering CTA and legal footer.

name: Settings Screen
description: An iOS-style settings screen with live search, grouped icon-tile rows, a working Airplane Mode toggle and a large title that collapses on scroll.
